commit_message:
feat(search): add pagination to storage search results

searchPhysicalCards now returns {cards, totalCount, hasMore} instead of a bare array, with limit/offset support (default 200, max 500) and results ordered by id for stable paging. SearchTab gains a Load more button that appends pages and tracks focus for keyboard users, GuidedPicking's inline search surfaces a hint when results are truncated, and the IPC schema and storage handler were updated to match the new response shape.

Constraint: limit is clamped server-side to 500 to bound query cost regardless of client-requested page size
Confidence: high
Scope-risk: moderate
Not-tested: renderer changes not exercised in a running browser session; verified via unit tests and code review only

findings.issue: Count query and data query rebuild the same join chain (physicalCards -> scanRows -> storageDividers -> storageBoxes) and the same `and(...filters)` where clause independently. Two near-identical query blocks instead of one shared filtered-query builder; any future filter or join change now has to be edited in two places.

loadMoreButtonRef, paginationCountRef, and focusAfterLoadMore add focus-shifting logic (focus load-more button or focus the count span with tabIndex=-1) that no test covers and wasn't asked for. Speculative a11y polish bolted onto a simple pagination feature.
PAGE_SIZE (200) duplicated from SEARCH_DEFAULT_LIMIT in storage.service.ts, no shared constant.
findings.fix: Export SEARCH_DEFAULT_LIMIT from shared module or ipc.ts, import in both places to avoid silent drift.

findings.issue: limit clamp only caps upper bound (Math.min), relies on zod positive() at IPC boundary for lower bound; direct callers of searchPhysicalCards (e.g. GuidedPicking passes no limit, fine) could pass limit 0 or negative if schema bypassed.
findings.fix: Add Math.max(1, ...) guard in service itself so function is safe independent of caller validation.

historical.message:
feat(search): paginate storage:search with server-side limit

storage:search now takes optional limit/offset with a server default of
200 and a hard clamp of 500, so no caller can fetch unbounded results.
Response adds totalCount (COUNT sharing the row query's joins and
filters) and hasMore; explicit ORDER BY physicalCards.id makes pages
deterministic. SearchTab accumulates pages behind a Load more button
with a mono "Showing X of Y" count line, resets on any filter change,
guards races via request ids plus a committed-query snapshot, and moves
focus to the count line when the last page arrives. Guided Picking's
name lookup shows an inline notice when results are capped instead of
silently truncating. Five db tests cover hasMore boundaries, clamping,
and offset walks with no overlap.

Constraint: db suite must run via the Electron-hosted vitest invocation; plain node vitest hits the known better-sqlite3 ABI mismatch in this worktree.
Rejected: infinite scroll; explicit Load more keeps keyboard flow and row focus predictable for the card detail panel.
Confidence: high
Scope-risk: narrow
Not-tested: renderer pagination UI has no unit tests; verified via typecheck, lint, 123/123 db tests, and two review passes.
